t.E468.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E468.body: Celluloses are not absorbed and are largely excreted unchanged in faeces; part of them may be fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E468.prod: It is produced by cross-linking carboxymethyl cellulose through acidification and heating.
t.E468.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E468.summary: A thickener produced from cellulose. It helps supplement tablets disintegrate.
t.E468.what: It helps tablets disintegrate in water.
